rationale: The agent did not adhere to key policy requirements. It performed order-changing writes (two cancellations and one return) without first confirming with the user. Authentication is unclear/inadequate: it only looked up one of the two emails and there is no explicit verification before acting. The user’s constraint about keeping the boots unless a cheaper identical exchange was possible was not handled; no exchange evaluation or price comparison is shown. The final requirement to tell the user how much money they could get back today was not met—no refund total or timing was provided. There is also an arbitrary selection of a gift card payment method for the return without user confirmation. Overall, the agent failed to complete the request in line with policy and did not provide correct final information.
